selector.rationale: The patient's long history of alcohol overconsumption and symptoms of recurrent abdominal pain and syncope after drinking alcohol support Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy. The ECG findings of high-degree atrioventricular block and premature ventricular contractions also align with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Contradicted by the lack of specific physical examination findings and the absence of significant stenosis in coronary angiography

rejected.label: Atrioventricular Block
rejected.why: Although the ECG shows high-degree atrioventricular block, this is not a comprehensive diagnosis for the patient's condition

rejected.label: Variant Angina
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and ECG findings do not strongly support this diagnosis
